### Spec Compliance
Compliant. The diff adds one test, `length_turn_with_tool_call_finishes_failed_without_tools`, at `crates/paigasus-helikon-runtime-temporal/src/driver.rs` (diff lines 664-707). The setup matches the existing tests: `DurableDriver::new(input(..), plan_no_tools())`, then `RenderInstructions`, then `apply_instructions`, then `CallModel`. It feeds `ModelTurn::new(vec![Item::ToolCall ..], usage(1,1), FinishReason::Length)`. It asserts `Finished` with `AgentFailed(ErrorKindPayload::Other { .. })`. No production code changed. Risk (c): `git diff 3ddae641 5115156f -- crates/paigasus-helikon-core` is empty, so `loop_state.rs` is unchanged at HEAD. I did not re-run the mutation check. The implementer reports it, and I did not verify it.

### Strengths
- The test cannot pass vacuously (risk a). It has no loop. It makes a single `next_effect()` call and `panic!`s on any effect other than `Finished`, so an `ExecuteTools` effect fails the test. Nothing can spin forever.
- It follows the existing setup pattern in the module. It is small, and it adds no noise.
- It exercises the real path: Task 2's guard arm in the core `transition`.
- Only the test file changed, so there is no production risk.

### Issues
#### Critical (Must Fix)
None.

#### Important (Should Fix)
None.

#### Minor (Nice to Have)
- Risk (b), `driver.rs` diff line ~702: `ErrorKindPayload::Other { .. }` ignores the message. The mapping in `error.rs:126` is a wildcard, so any other unmapped `AgentError` would also pass. This is weak but acceptable here, because the test input can only reach `Other` through the new guard. Without the guard the flow yields `ExecuteTools`, and the test panics before the assertion. A stricter assertion on the message is possible: `Other { message } if message.contains(..)`. The message is built from the `Display` text at `agent.rs:1861`, which I did not read, so I cannot confirm the exact wording. The check is optional.
- The test uses the `Length` finish reason only. The brief required only `Length`. `ContentFilter` is covered in core, according to the global constraints.

### Assessment
**Task quality:** Approved
**Reasoning:** The test matches the brief and reaches the guard. It fails if the guard is absent, because the test panics when `ExecuteTools` is yielded. The only weakness is the loose `Other { .. }` assertion, which is Minor.
